name: Solarchik CLOCK IN
tagline: Run across sunny rooftops and chat or talk with Sol, your AI pocket friend who remembers your day and cheers your streak.
description:
Solarchik CLOCK IN is a cosy daily game with an AI friend inside.

• Roof Run: guide Solarchik, a little solar robot, across city rooftops: jump, slide, dodge drones and mites and collect sunlight. Five roof worlds (Sunrise, Village, Storm, Night, Serpent), a daily shift goal, a weekly calendar and a streak to keep.
• Sol, your pocket AI friend: name them, pick how they talk (Sunny, Dry, Hype, Gentle) and a voice, then chat by text or hold the mic and talk. Sol answers in your language, comments on your runs live from the in-run radio, and keeps you company between shifts.
• Voice both ways: speech-to-text and text-to-speech run through Anna, so there's nothing to set up and no API key to paste.
• Daily yard: suns to spend in the shop, unlockable robots and roofs, daily heats.

AI on Anna: every conversation with Sol uses Anna's LLM (anna.llm.complete); voice uses anna.audio.transcribe / anna.audio.speak. The app has no external servers and no trackers. Game progress stays on your device.

Made by Solar DePIN Hub (Ukraine).
